# claude 2.1.305

Outcome files written by claude 2.1.305 in image `agent-claude:2026.10.21-1` (digest not recorded), captured
2026-10-29 on the lab's OpenShift pool. Each `<row>.json` is the agent's outcome file, byte for byte. `malformed.json`
is the truncated file the receiver read; the run ended `TASK_STATE_FAILED` "agent reported no outcome".
`no_state.json` is well-formed JSON with no `state`; the run ended `TASK_STATE_FAILED` "agent reported no outcome".
